test_set.english: The moderator resolving the report is the same agent who filed the report.
The proposer measuring the construct is the same agent who proposed the construct.
The reviewer approving the release is the same agent who built the release.
The verifier recomputing the blast table is the same agent who computed the blast table.
The monitor watching the deploy is the same process that performed the deploy.
The judge scoring the panel items is the same model that wrote the panel items.
The auditor certifying the ledger is the same account whose entries fill the ledger.
The teacher marking the exam is the same student who sat the exam.

manifest.method: For each pair, delta = len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) with tiktoken cl100k_base and o200k_base (version pinned in the roster names); per-model value is the mean over the eight pairs; the reported value is the mean of the two per-model values, lo/hi their min/max. Replication of dc50f8a3... with disjoint metric inputs: all eight pairs are novel self-audit scenarios.
